levels.name: Level 1
levels.tip: Tap your token, then tap a glowing hex next to it to multiply.

levels.name: Level 2
levels.tip: Hexes two steps away let you jump. A jump moves your token instead of copying it.

levels.name: Level 3
levels.tip: Land next to enemy tokens to convert every one of them to your colour.

levels.name: Level 4
levels.tip: A bigger board. Grow steadily and avoid leaving gaps beside your tokens.

levels.name: Level 5
levels.tip: Missing hexes are holes. You cannot land on them, but you can jump over them.

levels.name: Level 6
levels.tip: Multiplying adds a token; jumping does not. Jump only when the capture is worth it.

levels.name: Level 8
levels.tip: A token with no empty neighbours can never be captured.

levels.name: Level 10
levels.tip: When the board is full, whoever holds the most hexes wins.

levels.name: Level 14
levels.tip: Starting with more tokens? Spread out, but keep your groups solid.

levels.name: Level 19
levels.tip: Normal opponents look one move ahead. Guard the gaps next to your groups.

levels.name: Level 22
levels.tip: Three players! Let your opponents weaken each other.

levels.name: Level 25
levels.tip: Final tutorial test. Everything you have learned, on a bigger board.
